The '''Mgbo language''', ''''Mgbolizhia'''', is an [[Igboid languages|Igboid language]] spoken by the [[Mgbo people]] in [[Ebonyi State|Ebonyi state]] in [[Nigeria]]. It forms a [[dialect cluster]] with closely related [[izii language|Izii]], [[Ezza language|Ezza]], and [[Ikwo language|Ikwo]] languages though they are only marginally mutually intelligible.
